entries.claim: The circle is the set of points of a plane which are at constant distance from a fixed point in the same plane.
entries.quote: is the set of points of a plane which are at constant distance from a fixed point

entries.claim: The fixed point is called the centre of the circle and the constant distance is called the radius length.
entries.quote: The fixed point is called the centre of the circle

entries.claim: A circle is usually denoted by its center: circle M means the circle whose center is point M.
entries.quote: The circle is usually denoted by its center.

entries.claim: The set of points inside the circle, like points M, D, E, ...
entries.quote: The set of points inside the circle like points: M, D, E

entries.claim: The set of points on the circle, like points A, B, C, ...
entries.quote: The set of points on the circle like points: A, B, C

entries.claim: The set of points outside the circle, like points X, Y, Z, ...
entries.quote: The set of points outside the circle like points: X, Y, Z

entries.claim: Surface of the circle: the set of points of the circle ∪ the set of points inside the circle.
entries.quote: Surface of the circle : set of points of the circle

entries.claim: Radius of a circle: a line segment with one endpoint at the center and the other endpoint on the circle.
entries.quote: Radius of a circle : is a line segment with one endpoint

entries.claim: Two circles are congruent if their radii are equal in length.
entries.quote: Two circles are congruent if their radii are equal in length.

entries.claim: The chord: a line segment whose end points are any two points on the circle.
entries.quote: The chord : is a line segment whose end points are any two points

entries.claim: Diameter: the chord passing through the center of the circle.
entries.quote: Diameter : is the chord passing through the center of the circle.

entries.claim: Any straight line passing through the center of a circle is an axis of symmetry of it.
entries.quote: Any straight line passing through the center of a circle

entries.claim: From 1: the straight line passing through the center of the circle and the midpoint of any chord of it is perpendicular to this chord.
entries.quote: From 1 the straight line passing through the center of the circle

entries.claim: From 2: the straight line passing through the center of a circle and perpendicular to any chord of it bisects this chord.
entries.quote: From 2 the straight line passing through the center of a circle and
